lines.en: Swinging an iron sword forward.
Swinging a diamond sword while walking.
Roaming through the wilderness.
Hunting for targets to slash.
Swinging the sword at nearby enemies.

lines.zh: 我把剑横在身前慢慢走。
lines.en: I hold the sword across my body and walk on.
Swinging the weapon forward.
Walking with a longsword.
Charging forward with a sword swing.
Swinging the sword at nearby foes.
My sword drags alongside, scraping.
Iron or diamond, the blade pulls heavy.
Standing still with a sword.
Swinging to find a target.
Swinging the sword in a threat.
Swinging at the air.
Swinging the sword in the air.
Swinging the sword in an arc.
Swinging the sword to find prey.
Swinging the sword to look around.
Swirling the sword in the air.

lines.zh: 挥剑砍向空气中的假想敌。
lines.en: Swinging at imaginary foes in the air.
Showing teeth at the player.
Preparing to attack the player.
Pointing the sword at the player.
Swinging the sword towards the player.
Threatening the player with the sword.
Aiming the sword at the player.
Swinging the sword at the player.
Swinging to attack the player.
Charging at the player with a sword.

lines.zh: 挥剑准备对玩家发动攻击。
lines.en: Preparing to slash at the player.
Iron sword hits me!
Diamond sword cuts me!
I'm hurt, please help me!
Cutting wound hurts!
Sword wound suffocates me!
Sword blade cuts my skin!
Sword wound weakens me!
Sword wound bleeds!
Sword wound hurts!
You knocked my blade aside...

lines.zh: 你手中的剑比我的更好，或许我们可以交易？
lines.en: Your sword is better than mine. Maybe we can trade?

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被当作食物，你也不想吧？
lines.en: I don't want to be food. Neither do you, right?

lines.zh: 别小看了我的剑，它很锋利！
lines.en: Don't underestimate my sword. It's sharp!

lines.zh: 来吧，让我们一起战斗，互相帮助！
lines.en: Let's fight together and help each other.

lines.zh: 看看你能不能从我这里学到点什么？
lines.en: Maybe you can learn something from me?

lines.zh: 用你的剑换我的，可以吗？
lines.en: Can I trade my sword for yours?

lines.zh: 我手上的剑是用钻石打造的！
lines.en: My sword is made of diamond!

lines.zh: 你好像比其他人类更有趣。
lines.en: You seem more interesting than others.

lines.zh: 我的剑能帮你解决很多问题。
lines.en: My sword can help you with many things.

lines.zh: 让我们结伴而行，共享食物。
lines.en: Let's travel together and share food.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，必须解决你！
lines.en: You're in my way. You must be dealt with!

lines.zh: 你的速度很快，但我的剑更快！
lines.en: Your speed is fast, but my sword is faster!

lines.zh: 你阻止了我，必须付出代价！
lines.en: You stopped me. You must pay the price!

lines.zh: 我的剑锋利无比，你的头颅将随之落地！
lines.en: My sword is sharp. Your head will follow soon.

lines.zh: 别挡路，我要去寻找更强的对手！
lines.en: Move aside. I'm looking for stronger opponents.
You're too weak. You can't even stand a hit!

lines.zh: 你挡了我的视线，必须清除！
lines.en: You're obstructing my sight. You must be removed!

lines.zh: 你的存在让我很不舒服，离开！
lines.en: Your presence is bothering me. Get out!

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，你就是我的下一个目标！
lines.en: You're blocking my path. You're my next target!

lines.zh: 你的存在对我不利，必须铲除！
lines.en: Your existence is bad for me. I must remove you!

lines.zh: 来吧，我的同类，我们可以一起战斗！
lines.en: Come, my fellow. We can fight together!

lines.zh: 我们的力量结合，可以变得更强大！
lines.en: Our strength combined can make us even stronger!

lines.zh: 让我们一起，对抗这个世界！
lines.en: Let's fight this world together!

lines.zh: 我是同类，我们可以共享食物！
lines.en: I'm a fellow. We can share food!

lines.zh: 来吧，我的同类，共享战利品！
lines.en: Come, my fellow. Share the spoils!

lines.zh: 我们的力量可以战胜一切！
lines.en: Our strength can overcome everything!

lines.zh: 我们的力量可以保护彼此！
lines.en: Our strength can protect each other!

lines.zh: 来吧，我的同类，共享我们的力量！
lines.en: Come, my fellow, share our strength!

lines.zh: 我们可以一起，对抗这个世界！
lines.en: We can fight this world together!

lines.zh: 两个持剑的，能砍一整夜。
lines.en: Two swords can carve all night.
Pick up the sword!
Mine sword, you fool!
This is my sword!
Give me your sword!
Beware, sword in hand!
Your iron sword is worse than my find.
This sword is priceless!
Don't take my sword!
Protect yourself with the sword!
The sword is the only weapon!

lines.zh: 我这把剑是捡来的，但很利。
lines.en: I found this sword, but it's sharp.
My diamond sword is up — don't move.
Seize the moment!

lines.zh: 我手里是铁剑还是钻石剑？
lines.en: Iron or diamond blade in my hand?

lines.zh: 这把剑是出生就带来的。
lines.en: This sword came with me at spawn.
The prey is within reach!
Don't let it slip away!

lines.zh: 我闻到你的血，剑就抬起来。
lines.en: I smell your blood and the sword comes up.
I need its flesh!

lines.zh: 那把弓射得挺准，猎物在跑。
lines.en: That bow shot straight; the prey is running.
Time to switch the blade to my other hand.
I hear footsteps.
Someone's chopping trees up ahead.

lines.zh: 五个点的伤害，够你记住。
lines.en: Five points of damage will stick in your mind.
A scrap of cloth still hangs on my blade.
The tip of my blade circles your chest.
Enjoy my sword!
You'll beg for mercy!
My sword!

lines.zh: 我两格护甲，慢慢逼近你。
lines.en: Two points of armor, and I close in slowly.
Let the blood flow!
I am the master of the sword!

lines.zh: 我会让你尝尝剑的厉害！
lines.en: I'll let you taste the sword!
You deserve this!

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，让我更用力。
lines.en: The smell of rotting meat makes me swing harder.
Blade over my head, then down.
You back into a tree; no more room.
Two points of armor can take it.
My edge has gone a bit dull.
That shield won't hold a diamond blade.
The night is long; you won't get far.

lines.zh: 我的铁剑映着你的火光。
lines.en: My iron sword mirrors your torchlight.
Before I swing, I take a breath.
Swing at you!
Iron sword slash!
Diamond sword cuts you!

lines.zh: 我反手把剑背拍在你脸上。
lines.en: I backhand the flat of the blade into your face.
Iron sword swings!
Your head will fall!
Diamond sword shatters you!
Break your bones!

lines.zh: 我抡圆胳膊砍向你的颈。
lines.en: I swing in a full arc at your neck.
The iron sword comes down on your head!
The diamond blade splits your armor!
My sword lands on your shield!
The tip flicks at your wrist!
A zombie's hand does not shake!
Three cuts before I'm satisfied!
The flat of my blade slams into you!
Here I come, for the kill!
Another tasty meat patty!

lines.zh: 腐土里爬起来，钻石还亮。
lines.en: I rise from the rot, and the diamond still gleams.
Prepare for battle!
I hunt in the dark!
Seek new souls!
Rotten blade!
Hungry sword spirit!
Meat chunks, my favorite!

lines.zh: 我手里的剑生下来就是铁的。
lines.en: I spawned holding this iron sword.
I was spawned holding a sword.
Weight fifteen; I show up often.
I climb out of the dirt, blade in hand.
Night falls, and my blade gleams.
Flames are licking my sword hilt!
My sword sank to the bottom.
I drowned and suffocated!
The blast throws me down, but I keep my sword.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进我握剑的肩。
lines.en: An arrow pins the shoulder that holds my sword.
Magic burns me!
My belly is empty and the sword feels heavy.
My iron sword glows red.
Void consumes me!
